decision: Not selected: pilot and independent review both rate prose/dialogue and character distinction 3/5.
assessment_notes: Consistent invented history permitted under user clarification; raw older prompt restriction retained only as frozen historical input.
Both reviewers found no demonstrated material authorship or inaccessible-knowledge violation.
Independent review calls B12-13 a local dissemination chronology error. Pilot called it prospective-phrasing ambiguity. Both record it as a quality problem without erasing achieved court access.
Aldric promises a written inquiry at A14, but A15 proves repairs/reopening, not completion of that inquiry. Do not count promised accountability as an achieved result.
C6 and C7 received short screens only; neither has long-session validation.
